facts.name: memcmp
facts.label: address comparison

limitations: Logical owned map mutation under valid storage and successful allocation/entry premises. Physical outer ring/tree migration, allocator failure and unwind remain open.
Fresh nested tree has one96-byte key/value row. Exact initialized words are shown; opaque collections and padding are not assigned invented semantics.
Source stops at duplicate unwrap, balance panic or after aggregate store; no assumption about outer rollback, Once continuation, or target runtime equivalence.
